trends.topic: Cat House Soiling: Solving Litter Box Aversion Once and For All
trends.raw_quote: When a cat eliminates outside of the litter box it's probably the most frustrating behavior a cat parent ever has to cope with. All of a sudden, the cat who never caused any problems has suddenly started viewing the dining room carpet or living room sofa as makeshift litter boxes.
trends.notes: Clear user desperation across multiple sources. Reddit posts show people considering rehoming cats over this issue. Medical vs behavioral causes need clear differentiation guide. Solutions include vet visits, litter box setup, enzyme cleaners, environmental changes. Cat owner audience is large and emotionally invested.

trends.topic: Child Selective Eating: Getting Kids to Eat More Than 5 Foods
trends.raw_quote: I'm at my wits end. Every night, my little guy barely touches the meal. It's a real struggle! If your kid won't eat, it can be extremely frustrating, whether it's your baby, toddler or teen. When your child is refusing food, it can leave you angry, full of despair, and even hopeless.
trends.notes: Parents show deep frustration and fear about child nutrition. Quotes from real parents Debbie and Sara captured. Problem affects 30% of children. Sensory issues, food neophobia, and pressure at table all documented. Medical concerns about ARFID and weight loss driving parents to seek help. Large parenting audience, high willingness to pay for solutions.
